name: WindowsCraft
description: Screens in Minecraft: share your Windows screen or any app window onto a black concrete wall, or turn a wall, a gaming monitor block or a tablet into a real extra monitor for your PC (an in-game monitor), with spatial audio, for everyone on the server. Press U anywhere for the menu. Install it on the server too (it adds the gaming monitor blocks and tablets).
contributors: Arno Dölinger (3D audio engine, from Dream Displays)
